why: VS Code keeps its servers under "servers", not "mcpServers", and reads .vscode/mcp.json with comments and trailing commas. A reader that only knows mcpServers misses every VS Code server, and a strict JSON reader calls the file unparseable. The fail side is such a file with one unaccepted local server; the pass side is the same file plus its exact fingerprint in .rebar-injection-allowlist. Whoever reads only mcpServers turns the fail side into not-applicable; whoever parses it as strict JSON turns the pass side red.
